scope: Public work-order prior, single acquisition and common continuation. Exact reduced ratios. The two sensitivity variants use axes [predicted unserved service units, person seconds, tool seconds, issue fee].

endpoints.policy: Same order origin is consumed once, even with a copy at 0.5. A second origin must not borrow the first slot's action or recheck.
endpoints.zero_support: Positive-width bounded TAIL has no support in either finite variant. A valid report of this kind remains publicly visible.
